_what: The Jordanian legislation a legal assistant must be able to answer from (corpus coverage). scripts/corpus-inventory.ts reports, for each law and each SEPARATELY (none inferred from another): present in the database, servable, official source, Gazette-verified, current version, embedded, searchable, authoritative, number/year known. A law with no servable text is answered 'not in the database' (law_not_in_corpus) or, when its only texts are held back (quarantined / never checked), 'unavailable' (law_unavailable) — never from another law.
_verification: UNVERIFIED METADATA. Numbers and years are copied from this project's own download lists, and `evidence` names the exact record each is copied from (checked by src/lib/corpus/registry-check.ts, tests/unit/registry.test.ts): 'moj-list' = a file name on moj.gov.jo's law list (collected 2026-07-17, deploy/sources/moj-laws-ar.txt); 'moj-constitution-list' = deploy/sources/moj-constitution-ar.txt (no number or year); 'missing-list' = deploy/sources/jordan-core-laws-missing.txt, which says its numbers and years are for guidance and must be checked against the official file at ingest. None of these is a citation source. A qualified reviewer must confirm each entry against the Official Gazette before this registry is relied on.
